title: Refund eligibility
text: Customers have 7 days from delivery to request a refund. Submit the order number through the support portal.

title: Shipping updates
text: Customers can track a shipment from the order confirmation email. Contact support if tracking has not updated for 48 hours.

title: Return procedure
text: Pack the item securely and attach the prepaid return label from the support portal.

title: Payment processing
text:
Approved credits are issued to the original payment method.

Payment status inquiries must include the original ticket reference.
